author: MinoriaPrime1
quote:
*long review incoming* 
Alright so, this is a long review ahead boyos, get your popcorn and drinks ready for this one. 
I made an account just to say just how much I hate this worthless excuse and what these troglodytes have managed to do to this beloved franchise with just a single game. As a long time Rockstar and GTA fan, this game seriously pissed me off.

(You can skip this bit to read just the review of the game if you wish)

VVVVVVVVVV
Before we even get to the game itself, let's cover on what happened before the game even dropped:
Right from the get-go we're already starting off bad with the announcement that there will NO disk for the game, and me, being a lover of disk games, already left a bad taste in my mouth. THEN when you finally start shipping the games out with the codes in the boxes, you **** couldn't have bothered to actually put the damn things in a spot where people couldn't just outright steal them, not to mention the fact that some boxes shipped WITHOUT a code, and when people were flooding your customer support, of which I know a few of my friends that got screwed over, you either outright ignored refunds or just ignored everyone with radio silence.
VVVVVVVVV

Now, onto *THE GAME ITSELF* 

This... thing spits in the name of Grand Theft Auto. 
it has basically none of the DNA of what made the previous iterations of GTA so awesome, which is seriously impressive how they even managed to pull that off. It is GTA only in name. 
I have played every installment since GTA III, and I loved them all, loved the characters, the satire, the comedy, the freedom to do whatever you want, the list goes on. GTA VI, on the other hand, has basically none of what made the previous games amazing. The *only* thing I can genuinely say Is improved is the graphics and the car physics, but that's about where it ends, and it's not enough to counter everything else that is wrong with this dumpster fire ****.

*THE PROTAGONISTS*

Jason and Lucia are both terrible, bland characters, with personalities not too dissimilar to that of a wet paper towel. They are a microscopic fragment of what previous protagonists were in the GTA franchise. Oh but you may be asking "What about GTA 5? The protagonists are all also terrible people!", and you would be right. They ARE terrible people. However, I never felt like the game forced me to actually like them as people, and they actually had the chemistry, charisma and actual development to carry them, while this game does the opposite. 
Like seriously... did no one even clock that Lucia left her goddamn baby to commit a crime at the start of the game?? and then throughout the story it constantly felt like the game was yelling at me "LOVE HER GODDAMNIT"

*THE STORY*

The start was slow, but I didn't mind, I say to myself, since I've sunk ~600 hours in RDR2, I think it'll really pick up after chapter 1, but It never feels like it does, the whole time I'm thinking "Maybe it'll get better, might just need more time" and the chapters go on by and... I realize I've reached the end of the damn game... What??? How does end like that??? The whole story was just a romance nothing-burger with stupid quests all around. Who looked at the storyboard and went "Yup, that's the one". How and why anyone with a singular neuron firing off in their brain would say this is the best GTA, I have no idea. Rockstar have genuinely lost the plot. 
Anyone who praises this game deserves to be publicly shamed and have rancid sewer water dripped down their nose while they're tied to a chair upside down.
 
Every GTA game made me love the characters, and just get lost in the world, Red Dead Redemption 2 made me bawl my eyes out like a child. But this game made me feel absolutely nothing but boredom, disappointment and anger at how far they've fallen as a developer and took a big ole' steaming, fat, oily dump all over their fanbase, and people are celebrating it. 

Spend your 100$ elsewhere and don't make the same mistake I did.

Sincerely, **** you Rockstar. 
Never make another video game again, go **** on ogre toes.
